### Versioning fix
OpenLauncher now has one version number. Earlier builds told the TV they were **2.0.0** while their releases were tagged v1.0.x, so Dev Manager, Discoverium and other updaters never saw a new release. From this release on, the package version, the About page and the release tag all match.

The numbering jumps from v1.0.1 to **v2.0.1** so every updater sees this as newer than the 2.0.0 that TVs already report.

### Other changes
- The About page shows the release version even before the app list has loaded.
- Releases are built and published by GitHub Actions, including the 4K wallpaper video.

### Install
Download `com.homebrew.openlauncher_2.0.1_all.ipk` and install it with Homebrew Channel, Dev Manager, Discoverium or `ares-install`. You can also use **Update** on OpenLauncher's About page.
